description: This file defines and exports an array of color schemes for sequential color mapping, using the SequentialScheme class. It includes multiple predefined color schemes with properties like id, label, isDiverging, and colors.

classes.name: SequentialScheme
classes.description: A class representing a color scheme, imported from a relative path.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Creates an array of SequentialScheme instances from raw scheme objects.
